item.title: Trump’s Super PAC Is Tied to Mystery Group Spending $25 Million on Midterms
item.description: The recently created Republican group is pumping cash into half a dozen key midterm races, with the largest amounts going toward Senate contests in New Hampshire and Alaska.

item.media:description: President Trump’s main super PAC, MAGA Inc., has reported a war chest of more than $400 million.

item.title: The Establishment Pulls Through: Five Takeaways from the New Hampshire Primaries
item.description: The U.S. Senate race will feature familiar faces: former Senator John E. Sununu and Chris Pappas, a four-term congressman. Stefany Shaheen, a senator’s daughter, eked out a win in a House primary.
item.dc:creator: Jess Bidgood
item.media:credit: John Tully for The New York Times

item.title: Trump Is Orchestrating the Republican Midterm Convention Like One of His Rallies
item.description: The Republican Party is holding a midterm convention in Dallas this week. But as our White House correspondent, Maggie Haberman explains, despite President Trump’s unpopularity in polls, this event is shaping up to be a rally focusing on his achievements.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Haberman, Nour Idriss, Brian Oh and Whitney Shefte

item.title: Will Trump’s Midterm Convention Help or Hurt Republicans? 5 Things to Watch.
item.description: At an unusual gathering in Dallas, some of the party’s top candidates will be forced to decide just how tightly to tether themselves to an unpopular president.
item.dc:creator: Reid J. Epstein
item.media:credit: Shelby Tauber for The New York Times
item.media:description: Normally, national party conventions are held only in presidential election years, but President Trump pushed for a Republican midterm convention.

item.title: Texas Republicans Are Turning Against Data Centers. Will It Matter in November?
item.description: The industry’s rapid expansion has scrambled traditional political alliances and forced G.O.P. leaders to respond to a backlash from some of their most reliable rural voters.

item.title: Should Professors Teach More? Some Colleges Are Trying to Make Them.

item.media:description: Texas A&M University’s branch in Victoria, Texas, started requiring professors to work on campus five days a week. Some resigned.

item.title: As He Backs ICE Crackdown, Nebraska Governor Employs Undocumented Workers
